Upgrade to Java 17

Sonarqube requires Java 17 for both server and scanner side, so the
plugin no longer needs to support Java 11. The build has therefore been
upgraded to use Java 17, and Java 17 features used where possible.
Includes the removal of the Reflective Classloaders since they use
deprecated functionality and were never used.

Initiate release 25.10
[Gradle Release Plugin] - pre tag commit:  '{VERSION}'.

Fix release pipeline and reinitiate release 25.10

The release script was missing a dollar sign in a variable reference so
was printing out the variable name as the version number rather than
using the variable's value. The variable reference has therefore been
corrected and the version file reset to triggger a release build.
[Gradle Release Plugin] - new version commit:  '25.10.1'.

Add support for Sonarqube 25.11

Upgrades to the 25.11 front-end and back-end and upgrades the
BranchNewCodeDefinitionSettingModal to use the new combined New Code
Definition component in place of the removed individual New Code
Definition components that were removed from the updated Sonarqube
front-end.
Initiate release 25.11
[Gradle Release Plugin] - new version commit:  '25.11.1'.

Add support for Sonarqube 25.12

Upgrades to Sonarqube 25.12 for both back-end and front-end. As
Sonarqube no longer exposes commons lang, the relevant imports have been
replaced with lang3 imports. As the front-end requires the presence of
an `/api/support/info` endpoint for performing Bitbucket deprecation
checks, a webservice that exposes the required instance creation date,
but not any other fields that may be present in the commercial editions.
The front-end has also been altered to replace `useBranchesQuery`
references with `useProjectBranchesQuery` and update imports for
relocated components.
Initiate release 25.12
[Gradle Release Plugin] - new version commit:  '25.12.1'.

Add support for Sonarqube 26.1

Upgrades the plugin to use Sonarqube 26.1 back-end and front-end. Whilst
server-side is built using Java 21 for this version of Sonarqube,
scanner-side still support Java 17, so the project is being kept on Java
17 compilation target for now.
Initiate release 26.1
[Gradle Release Plugin] - new version commit:  '26.1.1'.
Return to SNAPSHOT version post release

Only publish Bitbucket Build report on Bitbucket cloud

Bitbucket server can be configured to block a pull request purely based on code insights annotations which are already being published by the Bitbucket decorator, so the build status report causes an extra block that may not be required. Conversely, Bitbucket cloud requires the build status to set a block. The decorator has therefore been altered to only publish a build status report if running against Bitbucket cloud, and to only use the code insights report when running against Bitbucket server.

Don't treat OkHttp Response body as nullable

OkHttp no-longer marks the call to retrieve the body from the response
as nullable, so performing null checks or wrapping it in
`Optional.ofNullable` flags alerts during static code analysis. The
null checks are therefore being removed and the body being treated as
always being present.

Fix authorization bypass in ProjectWsAction and DeleteAction

`hasEntityPermission()` returns a boolean that was silently discarded,
meaning permission checks were never enforced. Replace with
`checkEntityPermission()` which throws on failure.

#1213: Fix duplicated code snippet in Azure DevOps PR decoration

Swapped the start and end positions of the comment text range. In Azure DevOps,
providing a range where the end comes before the start (or is identical in a way
that confuses the UI) can cause the PR decoration to duplicate the code snippet
in the comment.

Use same details as Developer Edition for Azure Devops Decoration

Updates the Azure DevOps Pull Request decorator to use the same name, genre and description as SonarQube Developer Edition.

Use iterations for publishing Quality Gate to Azure DevOps

This setup works for multiple cases, when the user has "Reset status
whenever there are new changes" enabled and when "Reset status whenever
there are new changes" is disabled. It also works with PRs that don't
support iterations (it uses iterationId 1 then).

#1216: Add Support for Sonarqube 26.3

Upgrades the web and back-end dependencies to the latest version of
Sonarqube. As the new UI layout requires an addon to provide an
implementation of ProjectBranchSelector for the branch options to be
shown, the relevant component and dependencies have been created and are
being injected into Sonarqube through the existing add-ons configuration
process.

The Sonarqube update has also removed the `CenteredLayout` component, so
the impacted branch components have been update to remove or replace
reference to CenteredLayout.

#1216: Set alignment and width classes on branches app

The removal of the LargeCenteredLayout and switch to a div has caused
the 'Branches & Pull Requests' view to be missing spacing/margin around
the edges of the component. CSS classes have therefore been set on the
component to enforce auto-margins so the component is centered, and a
wide maximum width to ensure the content is constrained appropriately.

Prevent summary comment closure note being posted multiple times

The filtering of open threads only treated a thread as closed if it
wasn't a summary comment, so reposted the notice about a thread needing
manually resolved on each execution of the decorator. The filtering of
comments has therefore been changed to only consider whether a thread is
resolved or has the manual resolution comment on it, without considering
whether the thread is for a summary comment.

#1245: Update ProjectBranchesApp to new page layout

The ProjectBranchesApp page had not been altered to use the new
ProjectPageTemplate when the rest of the pages were upgraded, so was not
picking up the new banner and scrolling configuration that's present on
newer page layouts. By switching to the new layout we get a scrollbar
when we have more branches or pull requests than fit into the visible
content area.

#1254: Add support for Sonarqube 26.5

Bumps to the front-end and back-end for Sonarqube 26.5. Includes updates
to the release dockerfile to perform artefact retrieval in a separate
image to prevent build failure if tools distributed on the Sonarqube
image change between releases.
Initiate release 26.5
Fix gradlew.bat line ending handling
